==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:item}}
From {{inh|en|enm|item}}, from {{der|en|la|item||also; in the same manner}}. The present English meaning derives from a usage in lists, where the first entry would begin {{m|la|in}} {{m|la|primis}} (“firstly”) or ''imprimis'', and the other entries with {{m|la||item|t=also, moreover}}. Later, the members of lists were referred to as "items".

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈaɪ.təm/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈaɪ.təm/|[ˈaɪ̯.ɾəm]|[ˈaɪ̯.ɾm̩]|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-item.ogg|a=California}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɑe.təm/|[ˈɑe̯.ɾəm]|[ˈɑe̯.ɾm̩]|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈaɪ.təm/|[ˈɑe̯.ɾəm]|[ˈɑe̯.ɾm̩]|a=NZ}}
* {{hyph|en|i|tem}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A distinct physical [[object]].
#: {{ux|en|Tweezers are great for manipulating small '''items'''.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-26|author=[http://www.theguardian.com/profile/nick-miroff Nick Miroff]
|volume=189|issue=7|page=32|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/jul/23/mexico-insect-cuisine-sustainable-food Mexico gets a taste for eating insects]  {{...}}
|passage=The San Juan market is Mexico City's most famous deli of exotic meats, where an adventurous shopper can hunt down hard-to-find critters {{...}}. But the priciest '''items''' in the market aren't the armadillo steaks or even the bluefin tuna.}}
# {{lb|en|by extension|video games}} An object that can be [[pick up|picked up]] for later use.
# A [[line]] of [[text]] having a [[legal]] or other meaning; a separate particular in an account.
#: {{ux|en|the '''items''' in a bill}}
#: {{ux|en|In response to the first '''item''', we deny all wrongdoing.}}
# {{lb|en|psychometrics}} A [[question]] on a [[test]], which may include its [[answers]].
#: {{ux|en|The exam has 100 '''items''', each of which includes a correct response and three distractors.}}
# A matter for discussion in an [[agenda]].
#: {{ux|en|The first '''item''' for discussion is the budget for next year's picnic.}}
# {{lb|en|informal}} Two people who are having a romantic or sexual relationship with each other.
#: {{ux|en|Jack and Jill are an '''item'''.}}
#* {{quote-song|en|year=2010|author={{w|Justin Bieber}} featuring {{w|Ludacris}}|title=[[w:Baby (Justin Bieber song)|Baby]]
|passage=Are we an '''item'''? Girl, quit playin' / "We're just friends," what are you sayin'?}}
# {{senseid|en|short article}} A short [[article]] in a [[newspaper]].
#: {{ux|en|an '''item''' concerning the weather}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[hint]]; an [[innuendo]].
#* {{RQ:Fuller Church History
|passage=A secret '''item''' was given to some of the bishops {{...}} to absent themselves.}}
# {{lb|en|India}} {{ellipsis of|en|item girl}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2017|author=Nandita Chaudhary; Pernille Hviid; Giuseppina Marsico|title=Resistance in Everyday Life: Constructing Cultural Experiences|page=246
|passage=In this chapter, we will attempt to trace the course of initiation into the classical arts, from the self-taught gyrations of Bollywood '''items''' to the serious rigours of a classical Indian dance form.}}
